Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a lawyer and a receptionist about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The lawyer got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the receptionist scored well and was selected. Who is intelligent?
A. The receptionist
B. Unknown
C. The lawyer
